trap.label: falso cognato
trap.wrong: In some extension, results suggest a link.
trap.right: To some extent, results suggest a link.
trap.why: Em português “em certa extensão” soa parecido. Em inglês, extent (grau) é o termo correto; extension é prolongamento.

fix.wrong: The critic claim that costs fell.
fix.right: The critic claims that costs fell.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com extent: “In part, results suggest a link.” (To some…)
rewrite.answer: To some extent, results suggest a link.

rewrite.prompt: Aplique elipse: “She still hedges and I do not hedge.”
rewrite.answer: She still hedges and I do not.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com subject to: “Plans may change.”
